takeaways: Azure Local brings Azure management, governance and security to on-premises hardware, but it must be run like a local cloud with real expertise.
Azure landing zones, now usable with Azure Local through multiple subscriptions, keep environments separated, governed and secure through management groups, policy and least-privilege access.
Modernization beats lift-and-shift: assess with Azure Migrate, move to platform services where possible and automate recurring work with infrastructure as code such as Bicep.
hook: Not every workload can live in the public cloud, yet running a separate on-premises world creates silos and extra overhead. Azure MVP Christoffer Klarskov Jakobsen shows infrastructure architects how Azure Local, landing zones, Azure Arc and Bicep combine into one hybrid architecture. You will learn where to start and how to avoid simply lifting and shifting old problems.
